$comment: Invariant ids the P1 task `p1-path-and-ceremony` turns green in packages/core/src/path/. The integrate task merges these into docs/invariants-owned.json, which `pnpm test:coverage-map` reads; this file is the per-task manifest so two lanes cannot silently clobber each other's list.

notOwnedHere.INV-PATH-10: S, E - the section-complete canvas. UI, P3.
notOwnedHere.INV-PATH-11: S - exactly one pinned header at every scroll offset. UI, P3.
notOwnedHere.INV-PATH-12: P, E - the guidebook route. UI + scheduler, P3.
notOwnedHere.INV-PATH-24: U, C - the PathNode component registry with per-state art. packages/ui, P3.

falsifiers: packages/core/src/path/__falsifiers__/*.json, one per invariant, consumed by the tests whose names contain `falsifier` (pnpm test:falsify).

rulings.EC-PTH-21: Node unlock is linear within a unit AND unit n+1 unlocks only when the LAST node of unit n is complete; no early unlock on the first level. unlock.ts:unitAdvanced, falsified in __falsifiers__/INV-PATH-01.json.
rulings.S016 chest completion path: The chest is a node in the linear chain (captured Unit 1 shape: lesson, lesson, lesson, chest, lesson, unitReview), so it MUST have a completion path or every node after it deadlocks and the next unit never opens. Freelingo's chest declares the `chest` launch flavour - S016's `Open chest` (str:1573), one tap, no exercises, no failure - implemented in path/chest.ts. `canComplete` now treats an empty `launchable` as UNCOMPLETABLE and `placeableTypesWithNoCompletionPath()` is the registry gate. INV-PATH-19.
rulings.INV-PATH-13 overlay density: `jumpHereOverlays` emits one overlay per locked unit that HEADS A SECTION or is the NEXT LOCKED UNIT AFTER THE FRONTIER - the rule its doc comment always stated, matching S010/S019. The earlier code emitted one per locked unit, drawing eight `Jump here?` nodes on a 9-unit course. The narrowed set is a strict subset of `locked`, so EC-PTH-26 (the overlay disappears the instant its target unlocks) still holds.
rulings.INV-PATH-08 latch: `dailyRefreshLocked` deliberately does NOT read the `dailyRefreshUnlocked` latch. `locked iff the course is incomplete` is a biconditional over the current model, so a pack update that adds a unit re-locks the section; `unlocks exactly once` is about the ceremony and is the latch's job. Folding them together would lose the re-lock.
